surface_tiers.section_pills: Solid deep indigo (#29277B) compact pill badges with crisp white text for eyebrow and stage headers.
surface_tiers.standard_node: Quiet warm surface (#EFEBE3) with 1px #D9D5D0 border and custom indigo/periwinkle geometric micro-illustration.
surface_tiers.hero_node: Soft periwinkle tint (#E6E9F8) with #777FC3 border and bold deep-indigo (#29277B) geometric vector graphic; use for 1-2 core engine or decision nodes per diagram.
surface_tiers.success_node: Soft sage tint (#EDF2EA) with #5C7A4E accent icon and pill for hit/pass/fast-path nodes.
surface_tiers.takeaway_block: Soft terracotta-warm tint (#F2E7DF) with a thin clay-orange (#D7704E) left accent bar in the left column to balance the single clay-orange focal relation on the right.

typography.family_appearance: modern grotesk sans-serif; clear Simplified Chinese sans-serif
typography.main_title: regular to medium, approximately 132-160 px at the default canvas, adjusted for title length
typography.caption_contrast: supporting captions are ink at 70-80% opacity, never light gray on ivory

connection_line_craft.stroke_weight: visible but light, consistent across the whole image
connection_line_craft.corner_style: soft right-angle or one-curve elbows, no long unchecked diagonals
connection_line_craft.single_stem: each declared directed edge exits its source node as a SINGLE clean line (no double-forked loops or redundant parallel stems)
connection_line_craft.label_care: edge labels sit in reserved gaps beside the line, never overlapping strokes or node text
connection_line_craft.arrowhead: single, small, filled, exactly at the destination edge
connection_line_craft.feedback_routing: route all return, retry, or human-feedback dashed lines along the outer top or bottom perimeter corridor; never cross solid forward connectors

microtexture.rule: optional quiet paper grain at 2-4% strength, full-bleed flat artwork filling 100% of canvas edge-to-edge, no dot grids, no halftone, no outer card mockup shadow

copy_rules.eyebrow_length: 6-14 Chinese characters or a short English/Chinese label
copy_rules.headline_length: 10-18 Chinese characters; a full sentence reads better than a fragment
copy_rules.summary_length: one clause (<=24 chars recommended, hard max 32); short enough to minimize narrow-column line wraps
copy_rules.takeaway_rule: one factual sentence (<=36 chars); no imperative slogans or exclamation marks
copy_rules.caption_length: 6-16 Chinese characters (hard max 20); write the concrete object or action
copy_rules.qualifier_use: only when the section has a real trigger condition; otherwise omit
copy_rules.footer_length: one or two sentences, state scope or evidence limits

visual_quote_weights.rule: Balanced rich editorial hierarchy: deep indigo (#29277B) compact pills anchor stage headers; 1-2 core engine/decision nodes use soft periwinkle (#E6E9F8) while ordinary nodes use warm surface (#EFEBE3) and fast-path/pass nodes may use soft sage (#EDF2EA). Clay orange (#D7704E) is reserved for the single declared key evidence, risk, or cross-section transfer arrow (plus an optional quiet left-bar echo on the left takeaway block). No floating decorative micro-squares or pixel dots.

editorial.instructions: Keep the fixed two-column master: about 4% exterior margins, 25% left text column, 3% gutter and 66% right explanatory area. Use a fine vertical separator. The left contains a compact solid deep-indigo eyebrow pill above a large regular-to-medium title, a concise summary (<=24 chars ideal to prevent wrap typos), and one refined takeaway block. The right holds 5-8 nodes in declared section order with compact deep-indigo stage pills and 3-tier node surface contrast (warm #EFEBE3, hero periwinkle #E6E9F8, optional sage #EDF2EA). Keep custom clean geometric micro-illustrations inside key cards instead of generic tiny dots.

chapters.instructions: Use the chapter master: a compact full-width heading, then spacious horizontal chapter bands separated by fine rules at the fixed section gap (5-8 nodes total across bands). Within each band put a section number, heading, optional qualifier and one-sentence explanation on the left, and its technical relations on the right using 3-tier surface contrast. Connect cross-section flows explicitly through reserved horizontal corridors; route any feedback dashed line strictly along the outer perimeter corridor without crossing solid lines.

lanes.instructions: Use the lane master: a compact full-width title above clearly named horizontal lanes. Each lane represents an actual actor or execution phase with a crisp deep-indigo lane label. Keep 5-8 total nodes using 3-tier surface contrast; route arrows between lanes through reserved corridors, keeping feedback lines separate along the outer corridor and labeled with their actor and action.
